reviewed_hooks.Makefile.am: Installs local source data and docs. install-exec-hook removes only JOE variant link names inside DESTDIR/bindir and recreates links to the installed joe binary. DESTDIR and prefix must remain under owned project root.
reviewed_hooks.configure.ac: Autoconf compiler, header, function and library probes; no AC_RUN, AC_CONFIG_COMMANDS, downloads or privileged commands found. It detects optional aspell/ispell but does not run either during build.
reviewed_hooks.joe/Makefile.am: Builds the joe executable from reviewed local C sources; util subdirectory includes local helper programs only.
reviewed_hooks.rc/shell.sh: Provides commands for JOE shell-window feature; not executed by install or used by test scenarios.
reviewed_hooks.upstream_workflow: GitHub sync workflow contains curl network traffic; no upstream workflow is run.

runtime_risk: JOE supports !command filenames, shell windows and commands; test fixtures use only plain local file paths and keyboard editing. No shell, pipe, spell checker, grep, compile or external command features in the frozen route.
scope: Static hook review of exact extracted source only. Build and target execution remain pending.
